name: disciple_the_ashen_veil
description: a Disciple of the Ashen Veil, a cultist in a deep dark-grey hood that shadows his face, a brown fringe, a long dark-grey and charcoal robe with wide pale-grey sleeves, a red sash, a red-gem amulet, brown boots, a black book with a red eye sigil clutched to his chest with his RIGHT hand, and a curved steel dagger with a red grip in his LEFT hand
hands: the curved dagger stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand, on the screen-left side, clutches the black book to his chest

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; the hooded head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the arm holding the black sigil book flung out to the left, the dagger arm thrown up and out with the curved dagger)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the curved dagger dipping, the black book still clutched in the other hand

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the dagger arm flung up with the curved dagger, the arm with the black book drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the hood droops, the curved dagger lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the curved dagger's point resting on the ground, the black book hanging from the other hand
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the curved dagger slips out of the hand, the black book falls, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the curved dagger lies on the ground at the lower-right; the black book with the red eye sigil lies beside him; the grey robe spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the hooded robe settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, the hood fallen over his face, the curved dagger and the black book on the ground beside him
